issue.title: Describe the 670 config schema paths listed in the generated needs-description report
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1le.17 (config-registry, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1); triaged by the sase-1le land agent on 2026-10-16. The epic plan's config-registry phase said: "Fill the most-used ones in the schema; leave the rest as a follow-up note." This bead is that follow-up.

The generated report `docs/reference/config/needs-description.md` (tools/render_config, source `src/sase/config/sase.schema.json`) still lists 670 schema paths with no `description`, after the phase filled the commonly used parent fields. Most rows are array items (`...[]`) and dynamic-map values (`...<key>`), for example `ace.notification_rules[]`, `ace.snippets.<key>`, `dispatch.machines.<key>.tls.mode`. The generated configuration reference shows these entries with an empty description column.

Proposal: shrink the report to a short, deliberate list. Two levers, which the worker should weigh:
1. Add real descriptions in `sase.schema.json` for leaf fields under array items and dynamic maps that readers configure by hand (notification rules, dispatch machines, tribes, artifact panes, ...).
2. Teach `tools/render_config` to treat bare `[]` item and `<key>` value nodes as described by their parent when they carry no fields of their own, so container nodes stop inflating the count without hiding genuinely undocumented leaves.

Then regenerate with `just fix` (or `just fmt-docs`) and confirm `just fmt-docs-check` passes.

task_type_fields.proposal: Shrink docs/reference/config/needs-description.md (670 undocumented sase.schema.json paths) by describing hand-configured leaves and letting render_config treat bare [] and <key> container nodes as described by their parent.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1le epic planned only the most-used descriptions and explicitly deferred the long tail to a follow-up; the remaining 670 paths are schema-content work across many config families, not part of landing the docs redesign.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1le docs-redesign plan deferred the long tail of undocumented config schema paths to a follow-up, and phase sase-1le.17 proposed it at landing.

payload.entry: Breakdown at master 3e950ebdbd: all 670 listed paths sit under an array item or a dynamic map. 213 are bare array-item nodes ending in [], 51 are bare dynamic-map value nodes ending in <key>, and the other 406 are fields nested beneath such nodes. Top-level and named-object fields are already fully described.
